item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sri Lanka reached 83-2 at lunch after India enforced the follow-on on the fourth day of the second and final test in Colombo on Wednesday. Sri Lanka still trail by 130 runs. After declaring their first innings on 503-9, India bowled out the hosts for 290. Sri Lanka's Sonal Dinusha struck 103, his second hundred of the series, before their first innings came to an end. Mohammed Siraj dismissed Lahiru Udara (three) and Ravindra Jadeja sent back the other Sri Lanka opener Kamil Mishara (32) in their second innings. Pasindu Sooriyabandara was batting on 35 with Kamindu Mendis on 10 at the break. Siraj hurt his rib cage while trying to take a catch and walked off the field. India are 1-0 up in the two-test series.

item.title: El presidente surcoreano pide más control policial tras la polémica por las desapariciones en Jeju
item.description: El presidente de Corea del Sur, Lee Jae-myung, ha pedido una mayor rendición de cuentas por parte de la policía tras la indignación pública suscitada por la gestión de una serie de casos de desapariciones en la isla de Jeju, en un momento en el que se prevén reformas para otorgar a las fuerzas del orden un papel más destacado en las investigaciones penales.
item.dc:creator: Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Corea del Sur, Lee Jae-myung, ha pedido una mayor rendición de cuentas por parte de la policía tras la indignación pública suscitada por la gestión de una serie de casos de desapariciones en la isla de Jeju, en un momento en el que se prevén reformas para otorgar a las fuerzas del orden un papel más destacado en las investigaciones penales. "Es probable que la policía sea la institución estatal que ejerza mayor poder", dijo Lee en una reunión del Consejo de Ministros celebrada el martes, y añadió que la ciudadanía se preguntaba si las fuerzas del orden podían asumir esa responsabilidad. "La responsabilidad debe reforzarse en proporción a la magnitud de la autoridad". Cuatro personas cuya desaparición se había denunciado en Jeju fueron halladas muertas en tres días, hasta el lunes, según las autoridades. Los casos no guardaban relación entre sí, pero dos de ellos habían sido supuestamente archivados por el mismo agente, sin confirmar que las personas desaparecidas estuvieran a salvo. Las acusaciones han llevado a la policía a revisar las 298 denuncias de personas desaparecidas tramitadas por dicho agente. Según medios de comunicación, se están examinando unas diez de ellas por un posible cierre indebido. Uno de los casos era el de Jang Mi-ran, una mujer de 37 años cuya desaparición se convirtió en polémica nacional después de que, supuestamente, la policía archivara el caso sin confirmar que su paradero. Su cuerpo fue hallado el lunes, 104 días después de su desaparición. El otro caso se trataba de un hombre de unos 60 años cuya familia volvió a denunciar su desaparición, lo que dio lugar a una nueva búsqueda que concluyó con el hallazgo de su cadáver. Un tribunal dictó el martes la prisión preventiva del agente, acusado de incumplimiento del deber, falsificación de registros electrónicos oficiales y obstrucción de la función pública, según la agencia de noticias Yonhap. El agente negó los cargos y dijo que se había puesto en contacto con las personas desaparecidas, según esta información, que citaba a un responsable policial. La policía de Jeju declaró a Reuters que no tenía más comentarios sobre su gestión de los casos, lo que ha avivado la preocupación por la seguridad y las críticas en las redes sociales. Yoo Jae-seong, comisario nacional de policía en funciones, se disculpó y prometió medidas para evitar que se repita la situación. La policía ha ordenado que los casos de personas desaparecidas solo se archiven con la aprobación de un superior, a la espera de una actualización de su sistema de gestión de casos, explicó Yoo a los legisladores el lunes. "Examinaremos todo el sistema y haremos mejoras institucionales para que esto no vuelva a suceder", dijo Yoo, comprometiéndose a revisar todos los casos gestionados por el agente. La policía surcoreana recibió 70.814 denuncias de adultos desaparecidos el año pasado, según datos oficiales. Desde 2022 se han presentado más de 70.000 denuncias de este tipo al año, aunque la gran mayoría se resolvieron en un plazo de 30 días, según la policía. La polémica surge después de que el Partido Democrático, en el poder, privara a los fiscales de sus restantes competencias de investigación en julio, alegando un historial de abusos. El cambio, que entrará en vigor en octubre, otorga a la policía un papel de investigación mucho más amplio.

item.title: El ministro de Exteriores de Taiwán asistirá a la cumbre de líderes de las islas del Pacífico
item.description: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Taiwán, Lin Chia-lung, asistirá a los actos relacionados con una importante cumbre de líderes de los países insulares del Pacífico que se celebrará en Palau a partir de la próxima semana, informó el miércoles su oficina.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Taiwán, Lin Chia-lung, asistirá a los actos relacionados con una importante cumbre de líderes de los países insulares del Pacífico que se celebrará en Palau a partir de la próxima semana, informó el miércoles su oficina. El lanzamiento de prueba de un misil al Pacífico por parte de China en julio alarmó a las potencias regionales, pero no logró suscitar una respuesta unificada por parte de los Gobiernos de las islas del Pacífico, lo que pone de relieve las divisiones sobre cómo hacer frente a la creciente competencia estratégica en la región. China, que considera a Taiwán —gobernado democráticamente— como parte de su propio territorio, ha ido reduciendo gradualmente el número de países insulares del Pacífico que mantienen relaciones oficiales con Taipéi, de los que solo quedan tres: Palau, Tuvalu y las Islas Marshall. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Taiwán indicó que Lin partiría hacia Palau el jueves y permanecería allí una semana, participando en actos paralelos a la cumbre, entre ellos una reunión de diálogo del Foro de las Islas del Pacífico organizada por la secretaría del foro, y la Exposición sobre la Prosperidad del Pacífico. Lin se reunirá también con los aliados diplomáticos de Taiwán en el Pacífico y con "otras naciones amigas para intercambiar opiniones sobre la profundización de la colaboración entre Taiwán y las naciones insulares del Pacífico, así como sobre el mantenimiento conjunto de la paz, la estabilidad y la prosperidad en la región indopacífica", señaló el ministerio en un comunicado. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de China no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre la visita de Lin a Palau con motivo del foro, que se celebra desde el domingo hasta el 4 de septiembre. China ha ampliado su influencia en el Pacífico en los últimos años mediante la financiación de infraestructuras, la expansión diplomática y la cooperación en materia de seguridad, lo que ha suscitado preocupación entre sus socios tradicionales, entre ellos Australia, Nueva Zelanda y Estados Unidos.

item.title: Al menos 15 bebés mueren en un incendio en un hospital de Islamabad, según la televisión local
item.description: Al menos 15 bebés perdieron la vida tras un incendio en un hospital público de Islamabad, la capital de Pakistán, provocado por un fallo en los sistemas de aire acondicionado, informó el miércoles la cadena local Geo TV.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Al menos 15 bebés perdieron la vida tras un incendio en un hospital público de Islamabad, la capital de Pakistán, provocado por un fallo en los sistemas de aire acondicionado, informó el miércoles la cadena local Geo TV. El incendio se inició alrededor de las 7 de la mañana (0200 GMT) en el Instituto de Ciencias Médicas de Pakistán (PIMS, por sus siglas en inglés), en la tercera planta de la unidad de salud materno-infantil del hospital, según la cadena. El incidente es uno los incendios hospitalarios más mortíferos de los últimos años en el país, donde la sanidad pública está subvencionada, pero las instalaciones carecen de recursos suficientes y están sobrecargadas, mientras que los organismos de control han criticado con frecuencia la mala gestión de los centros públicos. Había 16 recién nacidos en la unidad cuando se declaró el incendio, uno de los cuales fue rescatado, según Geo. El primer ministro, Shehbaz Sharif, ha ordenado a las autoridades que lleven a cabo una investigación inmediata, informó su oficina. "Se debe identificar a los responsables y se deben tomar las medidas más estrictas", dijo la oficina de Sharif en un comunicado. La sala fue acordonada y se vieron ambulancias fuera del edificio del hospital, según un testigo de Reuters. El PIMS, situado en el centro de Islamabad —donde el ex primer ministro Imran Khan recibió tratamiento durante un breve periodo de tiempo la semana pasada—, es uno de los principales hospitales públicos de la ciudad.

item.title: BNP Paribas et KB Kookmin en discussions pour acquérir 15% de Techcombank au Vietnam - sources
item.description: BNP Paribas et la banque sud-coréenne KB Kookmin Bank discutent séparément de l'acquisition d'au moins 15% de leur concurrent vietnamien Techcombank , dans le cadre d'une transaction dont le montant pourrait atteindre 2 milliards de dollars (1,72 milliard d'euros), selon deux sources.
item.dc:creator: Yantoultra Ngui, Phuong Nguyen
item.content:encoded: BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) et la banque sud-coréenne KB Kookmin Bank discutent séparément de l'acquisition d'au moins 15% de leur concurrent vietnamien Techcombank (TCB.HM) , dans le cadre d'une transaction dont le montant pourrait atteindre 2 milliards de dollars (1,72 milliard d'euros), selon deux sources. L'opération, jusqu'ici non révélée, offrirait à son acquéreur un accès privilégié au marché bancaire vietnamien en forte croissance et mettrait fin à la longue quête de Techcombank d'un partenaire stratégique étranger. Techcombank vise une valorisation équivalente à environ deux fois sa valeur comptable, ont indiqué les sources, qui ont requis l'anonymat en raison du caractère confidentiel des discussions. À ce niveau de valorisation, une participation de 15% représenterait environ 2 milliards de dollars, soit une prime d'environ 55% sur le cours actuel. L'action Techcombank recule de 9% depuis le début de l'année à mardi. KB Kookmin Bank a déclaré ne pas commenter les rumeurs ou spéculations de marché, conformément aux règles sud-coréennes en matière de publication d'informations financières. Les porte-paroles de Techcombank et de BNP Paribas ont refusé de commenter. Des banques japonaises et sud-coréennes figurent déjà parmi les investisseurs stratégiques de certains des principaux établissements du pays. Le groupe japonais Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp (8316.T) a ainsi acquis une participation de 15% dans VPBank (VPB.HM) en 2023. SECTEUR BANCAIRE EN FORTE CROISSANCE La réglementation vietnamienne plafonne à 30% la participation étrangère dans la plupart des banques. Chez Techcombank, la part des investisseurs étrangers s'élève actuellement à environ 20,5% et les deux candidats envisagent plusieurs options, notamment le rachat de participations détenues par des actionnaires existants, ont indiqué les sources. Aucun accord n'a été conclu à ce stade et rien ne garantit que les discussions aboutiront, ont ajouté les sources, précisant que Techcombank ne devrait retenir qu'un seul candidat. La valorisation demeure le principal obstacle, Techcombank réclamant une prime nettement supérieure à sa valeur de marché actuelle, selon l'une des sources, qui ajoute qu'un investisseur stratégique miserait avant tout sur le potentiel de croissance futur de l'établissement. Selon les sources, un accord pourrait être conclu d'ici à fin 2026 ou au premier semestre 2027, en fonction de l'évolution des négociations. Techcombank affirme depuis longtemps être ouverte à un investisseur stratégique étranger. Elle figure parmi les rares grandes banques privées du Vietnam à ne pas disposer d'un tel partenaire. Une participation dans Techcombank offrirait un accès à l'essor de la classe moyenne vietnamienne, à la demande croissante en matière de gestion de patrimoine et au développement rapide de la banque privée dans le pays. Fondée en 1993, Techcombank comptait plus de 18 millions de clients fin 2025 et servait plus de la moitié de la clientèle vietnamienne fortunée, selon son rapport annuel 2025. Les actifs de la banque atteignaient 1.273.000 milliards de dongs (41,8 milliards d'euros) à fin juin 2026, tandis que les dépôts de clientèle s'élevaient à 697.400 milliards de dongs, selon ses états financiers. Le bénéfice avant impôt a progressé de 22,5% au premier semestre sur un an, porté par la hausse des revenus nets d'intérêts et des commissions, selon la banque.

item.title: MLB roundup: D-backs rally past Cubs on Ryan Waldschmidt's walk-off HR
item.description: Pinch hitter Ryan Waldschmidt hit a two-run walk-off homer with two outs in the ninth inning as the Arizona Diamondbacks overcame a four-run deficit to beat the Chicago Cubs 5-4 in Phoenix on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pinch hitter Ryan Waldschmidt hit a two-run walk-off homer with two outs in the ninth inning as the Arizona Diamondbacks overcame a four-run deficit to beat the Chicago Cubs 5-4 in Phoenix on Tuesday. Tim Tawa drew a walk from Jacob Webb (6-4) with one out in the ninth. Pinch runner Jose Fernandez stole second with two outs before Waldschmidt hit a 2-1 hanging slider 408 feet into the left field seats, giving the D-backs 40 comeback victories this season -- tied with the Cubs for the most in the majors. Waldschmidt is the first rookie in major league history to hit two walk-off homers while trailing in the same calendar month, also doing so Aug. 7 against the Dodgers, per OptaSTATS. The Cubs had scored 30 consecutive runs and had thrown 23 consecutive scoreless innings since falling behind the Seattle Mariners 2-0 in the second inning of a 19-2 win on Sunday until the D-backs scored three in the eighth on Tuesday. Chicago's Ian Happ hit a three-run homer off Brandon Pfaadt to break a scoreless tie in the fourth inning, his third long ball in five games. Cubs starter Clay Holmes gave up two hits, both singles, in seven scoreless innings, leaving the game with a 4-0 lead. Red Sox 7, Marlins 3 (11 innings) Jarren Duran slugged a grand slam as Boston defeated host Miami in extra innings to win its fifth straight game. Mickey Gasper homered twice for the Red Sox. He has five homers in his past eight games. Prior to that, he had no homers in 107 at-bats in the majors this season. The Marlins, who have lost two straight, were led by Heriberto Hernandez, who slugged his team-high 20th homer of the season. Both teams scored in untraditional ways in the 10th inning, Boston on a passed ball and Miami on a dropped third strike which would have otherwise been the third out and ended the game. Boston's Payton Tolle struck out seven and allowed two runs in 5 1/3 innings. Miami's Tyler Phillips lasted 4 2/3 innings, allowing one run and tying his career high with seven strikeouts. Mets 3, Brewers 2 (10 innings) Francisco Lindor homered and later scored the winning run as host New York beat Milwaukee in the opener of a three-game series. After Trevor Megill (2-3) walked Carson Benge and Luis Robert Jr., Christopher Morel hit a grounder to third which allowed automatic runner Lindor to score when David Hamilton's throw home was off-target. Jonathan Pintaro (2-0) walked one in a scoreless top of the 10th. Robert homered and had two hits for the Mets, who are 13-8 this month. Luis Lara hit a run-scoring single in the fourth and Christian Yelich delivered the game-tying, pinch-hit RBI double in the ninth for the Brewers, who have dropped two straight following a 6-1 stretch. New York rookie Zac Thornton gave up one run on seven hits over six innings. Kyle Harrison allowed one run on six hits over five innings for Milwaukee. Guardians 8, Angels 6 (10 innings) Jose Ramirez doubled three times and drove in five runs, capped by a go-ahead two-run double in the 10th inning, as Cleveland rallied from an early five-run deficit to defeat Los Angeles in Anaheim, Calif. Ramirez lined a double off Angels reliever Blake Weiman (0-1) into the gap in left-center to drive in Brayan Rocchio and Steven Kwan, leading the Guardians to their sixth straight win. Kwan went 5-for-5 with a walk, an RBI and three runs, matching his career-high hit total. Erik Sabrowski (5-2) struck out the side in the ninth, and Cade Smith fanned two during a scoreless 10th to pick up his 35th save. Vaughn Grissom hit two homers and drove in three runs, Mike Trout went 2-for-4 with a walk and a run and Christian Moore also homered for the Angels, who lost their third straight game. Pirates 1, Padres 0 Oneil Cruz lined a two-out solo homer in the top of the ninth inning to plate the only run in Pittsburgh's win over host San Diego. Cruz ripped a changeup from Mason Miller (4-2) 379 feet into the seats in right field for his 17th homer of the year and the first allowed by Miller since last August. Gregory Soto (6-4) pitched a 1-2-3 eighth inning to earn the win for the Pirates, who have won two straight against the Padres after coming into this series having lost 13 of their last 15 meetings against San Diego. Both starters pitched brilliantly but settled for no-decisions. Pittsburgh's Paul Skenes allowed just three hits in six innings, while San Diego's Michael King twirled seven innings and permitted five hits. Braves 4, Dodgers 3 Ozzie Albies hit a go-ahead RBI single in the eighth inning and Raisel Iglesias pitched around Shohei Ohtani's leadoff triple in the ninth as Atlanta held on to beat visiting Los Angeles. After Ohtani's triple, Iglesias struck out Freddie Freeman and got Mookie Betts to ground out. After Max Muncy was intentionally walked, Tommy Edman flied out to center field, preserving Atlanta's second straight win and ending the Dodgers' six-game winning streak. Braves starter Bryce Elder threw six innings of three-run, eight-hit ball while Los Angeles starter Tyler Glasnow, making his first start since May 6 after dealing with back issues, went five innings and allowed three runs on six hits with seven strikeouts. Astros 9, Yankees 7 Yainer Diaz homered twice, Yordan Alvarez hit a tiebreaking RBI triple with two outs in the eighth inning and Houston outlasted host New York. Diaz started the deciding three-run rally off Brent Headrick (7-3) by homering to right with one out to tie the game 6-6. After a single by Jeremy Pena, Alvarez roped a first-pitch slider to the warning track in right-center field before scoring on a single by Isaac Paredes. Spencer Jones doubled and Jazz Chisholm Jr. singled him home to kick off the bottom of the eighth but Bryan Abreu (5-3) got Austin Wells to ground into a double play and Josh Hader finished it off by notching the final four outs for his 19th save in 19 chances. White Sox 11, Rangers 7 Tristan Peters delivered a two-run double during a six-run first inning and homered for the fourth straight game as host Chicago held off Texas. Chicago evened the series between American League playoff contenders at one game apiece. The White Sox out-hit the Rangers 14-11, but needed a ninth-inning escape despite their strong start as Grant Taylor came on with the bases loaded and two out to get Cody Freeman to ground into a forceout at second to end the game. Rangers starter Jacob deGrom allowed the first five batters of the game to reach base. deGrom (9-9) went only 3 2/3 innings, giving up eight runs. Chicago left-hander Anthony Kay benefited from the early run support but fell one out short of qualifying for the victory after giving up four runs over 4 2/3 innings. Mariners 4, Phillies 1 Cal Raleigh homered and George Kirby pitched 7 2/3 strong innings as Seattle defeated visiting Philadelphia for a fourth win in five games. Kirby (9-10) allowed one run on six hits and a walk while striking out nine. Mariners closer Andres Munoz worked the ninth for his 24th save of the season. Raleigh, who went deep three times on Monday, tied the team record of four homers in as many at-bats. Bryce Harper had two hits for the Phillies, who have lost two in a row after a nine-game winning streak. Aaron Nola (5-10) permitted two runs on three hits in six innings. Royals 5, Blue Jays 3 Salvador Perez knocked in the go-ahead run with a fifth-inning single and Kansas City held off host Toronto for its ninth straight victory. The game ended when Toronto's Nathan Lukes was thrown out at second trying to stretch his two-run single off Steven Cruz into a double. Left fielder Isaac Collins got the ball to shortstop Bobby Witt Jr., whose throw to second got Lukes. Kansas City starter Seth Lugo (6-7) allowed one run on six hits and one walk with five strikeouts in five innings, while Toronto's Max Scherzer (1-7) allowed two runs in five innings as he dropped a seventh straight decision. Rockies 3, Nationals 1 Hunter Goodman homered in his return from the injured list as Colorado snapped a seven-game losing streak with a win at Washington. The Rockies, who entered the game with the fourth-highest bullpen ERA in the majors (4.88), got five innings of scoreless relief from relievers. Mark Manfredi (1-0) pitched one inning for his first big league win and Jordan Romano worked the ninth for his 13th save. The Nationals lost for the ninth time in 11 games. Washington went 0-for-6 with runners in scoring position and totaled five hits one night after scoring 13 runs on 13 hits. Mason Adams started for Colorado and pitched four innings in his major league debut. Orioles 13, Cardinals 1 Pete Alonso went 4-for-4 with a three-run home run and Christian Encarnacion-Strand also homered and drove in three runs as Baltimore hammered host St. Louis. Jackson Holliday added three hits and right-hander Chris Bassitt pitched effectively into the seventh inning for the Orioles, who remain in the thick of a crowded AL wild-card race despite being four games under .500. Alonso's 31st homer of the season keyed a four-run third inning and Encarnacion-Strand's seventh homer capped it. Bassitt (5-4) gave the Orioles a boost in his third start back since having surgery in June to remove bone spurs from his back, allowing a run on six hits (five singles) over 6 2/3 innings. Tigers 4, Rays 1 Max Clark hit his second career home run to help propel host Detroit to a victory over Tampa Bay which ended its six-game losing streak. Javier Baez scored two runs and Hao-Yu Lee added an RBI single for the Tigers. Detroit starter Jackson Jobe gave up one run in 4 1/3 innings. Drew Sommers (1-3) didn't allow a baserunner in 1 2/3 innings while picking up his first major league win. Kenley Jansen got the last three outs to record his 17th save. Bulk Rays reliever Ian Seymour (9-5) gave up all four runs -- three earned -- and seven hits in the final 5 2/3 innings. Junior Caminero had two hits and scored the lone run for the AL East leaders, who scored first in the fourth. Jonny DeLuca had the lone RBI. Athletics 4, Twins 2 Carlos Cortes hit a two-run homer and Gage Jump pitched into the seventh inning as the Athletics beat Minnesota in West Sacramento, Calif. Lawrence Butler had two hits for the Athletics, who won for the third time in four games. Jump (6-8) allowed two runs on three hits over 6 1/3 innings. Hogan Harris recorded two outs, Luis Medina pitched a scoreless eighth inning and Elvis Alvarado retired the Twins in order in the ninth for his fourth save. Royce Lewis had two of the Twins' four hits. Minnesota struck out 12 times and lost for the fourth time in five games. Right-hander Taj Bradley (9-6) threw the first immaculate inning (three strikeouts on nine total pitches) in Twins history in the fifth inning but allowed four runs on seven hits over 6 2/3 innings. Giants 3, Reds 1 Rafael Devers homered again, another pitcher got injured early in his start, and San Francisco followed a winning -- albeit painful -- script to beat visiting Cincinnati. One night after they built an early lead and lost starting pitcher Carson Whisenhunt to an elbow injury, the Giants repeated the pattern. Adrian Houser exited due to arm tightness in the second inning, and he will undergo an MRI on Wednesday. Anthony Molina (1-0) threw 4 1/3 innings to win his Giants debut. Carson Seymour was credited with his first career save despite serving up a Sal Stewart homer in the ninth. San Francisco's Drew Cavanaugh had three hits and two RBIs. --Field Level Media

item.title: Hyundai lifts margin target, expands US hybrid lineup
item.description: Hyundai Motor on Wednesday unveiled plans to add 1.27 million units of production capacity by 2030 and expand its U.S. hybrid lineups, as the South Korean automaker seeks to lift its operating profit margin above 9% within four years.
item.dc:creator: Heekyong Yang, Heejin Kim
item.content:encoded: Hyundai Motor (005380.KS) on Wednesday unveiled plans to add 1.27 million units of production capacity by 2030 and expand its U.S. hybrid lineups, as the South Korean automaker seeks to lift its operating profit margin above 9% within four years. Hyundai said it would launch or refresh over 100 vehicles globally by 2030, over half of which will be in North America, as it seeks to regain ground against rivals and enter new segments. New models would include the Santa Fe extended-range electric vehicle (EREV), its first EREV that it will build at its Alabama plant, as well as a luxury hybrid model. It is a "product offensive across every region," Hyundai said, adding that it was also targeting ‘white spaces’ where its brand is underrepresented today. "These segments account for roughly 29% of all automotive sales, highlighting significant opportunities for growth." Hyundai said it would raise its 2030 consolidated operating margin target from the 8%-9% range previously forecast to above 9%, while keeping its 2026 margin guidance at 6.3%-7.3%. Hyundai also reaffirmed a target of 5.55 million global vehicle sales by 2030, equivalent to a 6% market share, and said electrified vehicles would account for 60% of sales by then, compared with 23% in 2025. "Our fundamentals have never been stronger," CEO Jose Munoz said, pointing to Hyundai Motor Group's global position. Hyundai Motor, together with affiliate Kia Corp (000270.KS) , is the world's third-biggest automaker by sales. RISKS AND ROBOTS Hyundai's U.S. push comes as higher gasoline prices linked to the Iran war have strengthened demand for fuel-efficient vehicles, particularly hybrids. Some 56% of U.S. car shoppers said rising gasoline prices made them more likely to consider a hybrid according, to Cox Automotive data, while hybrid sales rose 19% in the first half of 2026 according to Omdia. Hyundai's hybrid sales climbed 71% in the second quarter. However, Hyundai's U.S. expansion also faces trade policy risk from the ongoing review of the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), which governs duty-free access for vehicles and parts moving across North America. U.S. officials have declined to extend the agreement automatically, raising the prospect of annual reviews and less certainty for capital-intensive investment plans that depend on cross-border supply chains. Hyundai also outlined plans to broaden its businesses, including robotics, autonomous driving and robotaxis. It said deliveries of IONIQ 5 vehicles to Alphabet's Waymo for use as robotaxis would begin in the fourth quarter of 2026. Hyundai's Motional venture is also due to launch driverless commercial services later this year, initially in Las Vegas. The automaker said it would begin U.S. production of robots in 2028, targeting annual capacity of 30,000 units. It plans to deploy Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid robot at its Georgia Metaplant from 2028. Hyundai is testing how humanoid robots could be used in car production at a facility in Georgia that replicates factory floor conditions. The company also said it would bring online a 100-megawatt AI data center from 2029, with capacity for more than 50,000 graphics processing units (GPUs), as it expands software-defined vehicles and autonomous driving systems. Hyundai said it would cancel treasury shares worth about 789 billion won ($570 million), while maintaining a shareholder payout ratio of at least 35%. Shares of Hyundai Motor increased losses to fall 3.3% after the announcements, versus the benchmark KOSPI's (.KS11) 1.3% rise as of 0557 GMT. ($1 = 1,384.8000 won)

item.title: EZB-Direktorin Schnabel spricht sich für höheren Leitzins aus
item.description: Angesichts der hartnäckig hohen Inflation hält EZB-Direktorin Isabel Schnabel ein höheres Leitzinsniveau für nötig. "Beim aktuellen Leitzins ist es unwahrscheinlich, dass die Inflation mittelfristig auf das Zielniveau zurückkehrt", sagte sie der Finanznachrichtenagentur Bloomberg am Mittwoch. Sie verwies darauf, dass sich der Konflikt im Nahen Osten hinziehe und die robuste Wirtschaft der Euro-Zone Aufwärtsrisiken für die Inflation berge. Schnabel ist mit dieser Einschätzung im Führungskreis der Europäischen Zentralbank (EZB) nicht allein: Angesichts einer Teuerungsrate von fast drei Prozent und steigender Energiepreise halten die Währungshüter nach Informationen der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters den Zeitpunkt für eine weitere Zinserhöhung für gekommen.

item.content:encoded: Angesichts der hartnäckig hohen Inflation hält EZB-Direktorin Isabel Schnabel ein höheres Leitzinsniveau für nötig. "Beim aktuellen Leitzins ist es unwahrscheinlich, dass die Inflation mittelfristig auf das Zielniveau zurückkehrt", sagte sie der Finanznachrichtenagentur Bloomberg am Mittwoch. Sie verwies darauf, dass sich der Konflikt im Nahen Osten hinziehe und die robuste Wirtschaft der Euro-Zone Aufwärtsrisiken für die Inflation berge. Schnabel ist mit dieser Einschätzung im Führungskreis der Europäischen Zentralbank (EZB) nicht allein: Angesichts einer Teuerungsrate von fast drei Prozent und steigender Energiepreise halten die Währungshüter nach [USN:L8N44N04D TEXT:"Informationen"] der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters den Zeitpunkt für eine weitere Zinserhöhung für gekommen. Um die wirtschaftlichen Folgen des Iran-Krieges einzudämmen, seien sie bereit, den Leitzins von 2,25 auf 2,50 Prozent anzuheben, sagten drei mit dem Vorgang vertraute Personen. Weitere Straffungen im Anschluss dürften sie jedoch kaum in Aussicht stellen. Die EZB lehnte eine Stellungnahme dazu ab. Der nächste Zinsentscheid der EZB steht auf einer auswärtigen Sitzung am 10. September in Berlin an. Die Zentralbank hatte die Zinsen im Juni erstmals seit fast drei Jahren erhöht, um zu verhindern, dass der kriegsbedingte Anstieg der Energiepreise auf breite Teile der Wirtschaft übergreift. Ein weiterer Zinsschritt soll die Entschlossenheit der EZB signalisieren, eine Wiederholung der massiven Teuerungswelle zu vermeiden, die 2022 auf den russischen Einmarsch in die Ukraine folgte. Die EZB strebt eine Teuerungsrate von 2,0 Prozent an.

item.title: Las tasas del BCE deben seguir subiendo por los riesgos de inflación, dice Schnabel a Bloomberg
item.description: Isabel Schnabel, miembro del Consejo de Gobierno del Banco Central Europeo, dijo en una entrevista con Bloomberg News publicada el miércoles que las tasas de interés deben subir aún más, mientras el conflicto en Oriente Medio se prolonga y la sólida economía de la zona del euro plantea riesgos al alza para la inflación.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Isabel Schnabel, miembro del Consejo de Gobierno del Banco Central Europeo, dijo en una entrevista con Bloomberg News publicada el miércoles que las tasas de interés deben subir aún más, mientras el conflicto en Oriente Medio se prolonga y la sólida economía de la zona del euro plantea riesgos al alza para la inflación. "Con la tasa de interés oficial actual, es poco probable que la inflación vuelva al objetivo a medio plazo, por lo que será necesario un mayor endurecimiento", dijo Schnabel a Bloomberg. Tres fuentes comunicaron el martes a Reuters que los responsables del BCE se inclinaban por una subida de tasas en su reunión de septiembre para contener el impacto inflacionista de la guerra en Irán, pero que no tienen mucha intención de dar señales de un endurecimiento adicional más allá de eso. Schnabel señaló que es probable que el crecimiento de los precios al consumo supere el 2% durante un "periodo prolongado" debido a los elevados costos energéticos, y que actuar solo cuando esto se refleje en los salarios dejaría a los responsables de la política monetaria "por detrás de la curva". El BCE subió las tasas de interés por primera vez en casi tres años en junio para evitar que la subida de los precios de la energía, provocada por la guerra, se extendiera demasiado por la economía. Schnabel afirmó que los mercados "parecen comprender muy bien nuestra función de reacción", sin especificar hasta qué punto es probable que sigan subiendo las tasas de interés.

item.title: Lynas expands global footprint, eyes new rare earths supply deals
item.description: Australia's Lynas Rare Earths LYC.AX said it planned to grow its global supply chain on Wednesday, with discussions to secure new mine supply from project developers around the world and set up a magnet processing facility in the United States.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's Lynas Rare Earths <LYC.AX> said it planned to grow its global supply chain on Wednesday, with discussions to secure new mine supply from project developers around the world and set up a magnet processing facility in the United States. The comments came after the world's biggest producer of rare earths outside China reported a sharp rise in annual profit, helped by record average selling prices for rare-earth oxide and strong demand, but missed market expectations. Its shares fell as much as 8%. Interim CEO Pol Le Roux said Lynas is in talks with project developers of ionic clay deposits around the world for new supply and expects to announce new deals soon. He did not say whether that would involve buying material or acquiring ionic clay businesses. "I think they held the door ajar and they're considering all of that," said Barrenjoey analyst Daniel Morgan. Le Roux also said Lynas was in early-stage talks with various parties to develop a magnet-making facility in the U.S. "But we are on track on that development and more development is to come," he said on an earnings call. The U.S., Europe and their allies are racing to build supply chains to reduce their dependence on China, which accounts for some 90% of global production of rare earth products, including magnets used in the aerospace, automotive and defence industries. A one-year suspension on export controls announced by China on several medium and heavy rare earth products expires in November. SOARING PROFIT MISSES FORECASTS Lynas posted a net profit after tax of A$222.4 million ($159.37 million) for the year ended June 30, up from A$8 million a year ago. That missed a Visible Alpha consensus estimate of A$242.5 million. It flagged operational challenges tied to ore quality at its Mt Weld mine in Australia, as well as rising costs. However it said it has resolved quality issues at its Kalgoorlie plant. "They have fixed a whole bunch of problems. It's nice to know they have found better operational stability," Morgan added. The earnings surge was driven by firm prices and floor price agreements with both Japanese and U.S. customers, which helped reduce volatility, Lynas said. Its average selling price rose 59% to A$80.7 per kilogram, helped by improved pricing of neodymium-praseodymium, a key rare‑earth magnet material, and a higher share of heavy rare-earth sales and sales with pricing not linked to the market index. Customers continued to prioritise sustainable rare-earth supply chains outside China amid export restrictions, while strong demand lifted sales volumes, it said. The company is searching for a new CEO, following the retirement of [USN:L4N3YD1VT TEXT:"Amanda Lacaze"]. ($1 = 1.3955 Australian dollars) (This story has been refiled to correct Lynas' Reuters Instrument Code in paragraph 1.)

item.title: Former Bayern quartet part of group investing in Portuguese side Estrela
item.description: A quartet of former Bayern Munich players including German World Cup winners Thomas Mueller and Mats Hummels are part of an investment group which has completed the acquisition of a majority stake in Estrela da Amadora, the Portuguese club said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A quartet of former Bayern Munich players including German World Cup winners Thomas Mueller and Mats Hummels are part of an investment group which has completed the acquisition of a majority stake in Estrela da Amadora, the Portuguese club said. "Estrela da Amadora hereby informs that the acquisition of a majority stake of 90% of the SAD's share capital by an international consortium led by ADvantage and LEAD, with the support of the KI Group, has been completed," the club said in a statement on Tuesday. "The new shareholder structure brings together investors with experience in sports, investment, and technology, as well as a group of strategic investors connected to international football, including Thomas Mueller, Mats Hummels, Yann Sommer, and Lucas Hernandez." Portuguese newspaper A Bola said the group paid €40 million ($46.65 million) for the stake in the top-flight side. Estrela were founded in 2020, nine years after the dissolution of their similarly named predecessor due to financial issues. They finished 15th in the Primeira Liga last season. While Hummels retired last year, 36-year-old Mueller plays for Vancouver Whitecaps in Major League Soccer. Hernandez plays for Paris Saint-Germain while Swiss goalkeeper Sommer plies his trade with Belgian side Club Brugge. Mueller and Hummels were part of the German squad which won the World Cup in 2014, while defender Hernandez helped France to victory four years later in Russia. ($1 = 0.8574 euros)

item.title: AVANT PAPIER L'Islande décidera samedi si son avenir est au sein de l'UE
item.description: Il y a cinquante ans, Gylfi Geirsson et Sigurbjorn Svavarsson coupaient les câbles des chaluts britanniques et échappaient à la Royal Navy à bord de petits navires des garde-côtes, utilisant des tactiques de guérilla pour tenir les flottes étrangères à l'écart.
item.dc:creator: Stine Jacobsen, Tom Little
item.content:encoded: Il y a cinquante ans, Gylfi Geirsson et Sigurbjorn Svavarsson coupaient les câbles des chaluts britanniques et échappaient à la Royal Navy à bord de petits navires des garde-côtes, utilisant des tactiques de guérilla pour tenir les flottes étrangères à l'écart. L'Islande est sortie victorieuse de ces affrontements connus sous le nom de "guerres de la morue" et le contrôle de ces eaux est devenu le fondement de son économie. Un demi-siècle plus tard, la crainte de perdre ce pouvoir est au coeur du référendum du samedi 29 août sur une réouverture des négociations d'adhésion à l'Union européenne (UE). Pour beaucoup, il s'agit de savoir si des taux d'intérêt plus bas et une place à la table européenne justifient de céder une partie du contrôle des pêcheries et de l'autodétermination, les bases de l'indépendance islandaise depuis la séparation du Danemark il y a huit décennies. INQUIÉTUDES LIÉES À TRUMP ET AU COÛT DE LA VIE Le débat reste centré sur les droits de pêche, mais porte aussi sur le coût de la vie et les menaces du président américain Donald Trump de prendre le contrôle du Groenland voisin, ce qui soulève des interrogations sur la défense de l'Islande. "Ce que je vois aujourd'hui, c'est la crainte de perdre le contrôle de ce pour quoi nous nous sommes battus", a déclaré Sigurbjorn Svavarsson, second à bord du navire des garde-côtes, au plus fort des guerres de la morue. Il devrait voter contre la reprise des négociations. L'Islande a déposé sa candidature à l'UE en 2009, après l'effondrement de son système bancaire l'année précédente. Quatre années de négociations plus tard, un gouvernement eurosceptique a suspendu le processus en 2013. SONDAGES PARTAGÉS "Je voterai certainement oui", a déclaré Gylfi Geirsson, opérateur radio lors des affrontements avec le Royaume-Uni, qui a ensuite représenté l'Islande dans des négociations internationales sur la pêche. "Nous ne pouvons pas être une île isolée au milieu de nulle part. Nous devons coopérer avec les pays voisins", a-t-il dit, ajoutant vouloir connaître les termes d'un éventuel accord avant de se prononcer définitivement. Il voterait toutefois contre l'entrée dans l'UE si l'Islande devait perdre le contrôle de ses zones de pêche. "J'aurais l'impression que tout ce que j'ai fait étant jeune n'a servi à rien", a-t-il ajouté. Selon un sondage Gallup publié ce mois-ci, 46% des électeurs soutiennent la reprise des négociations et 46% s'y opposent, tandis que 8% restent indécis. Les sondages montrent toutefois qu'une majorité est opposée à une adhésion effective à l'Union. PÊCHE, SYMBOLE DE SOUVERAINETÉ La pêche demeure un pilier de l'économie et de l'identité islandaises, aux côtés de l'aluminium et du tourisme. Une grande partie de la morue servie dans les "fish and chips" britanniques provient aujourd'hui des eaux islandaises, héritage du conflit auquel Gylfi Geirsson et Sigurbjorn Svavarsson ont participé. Heidrun Marteinsdottir, directrice de l'organisation Fisheries Iceland, indique que le secteur transforme l'intégralité de ses prises en Islande plutôt que d'exporter du poisson brut. L'application de la politique commune de la pêche de l'UE pourrait, selon elle, remettre en cause ce modèle. "Nous conservons 100% des profits en Islande et nous voulons que cela reste ainsi", a-t-elle déclaré. "La pêche est devenue un symbole de la souveraineté islandaise", a déclaré Eirikur Bergmann, professeur à l'université de Bifröst. Selon lui, aucun ministre des Affaires étrangères ne pourrait signer un traité cédant le contrôle de la pêche. "Cette personne serait expulsée du pays", a-t-il dit. Pour d'autres, l'enjeu va au-delà du poisson. "Nous avons autrefois été une colonie danoise", a dit Floki, designer de Reykjavik. "Je pense qu'il s'agit avant tout de garder le contrôle de nos propres choix et décisions". SÉCURITÉ ET RUSSIE L'Islande se trouve sur le passage Groenland-Islande-Royaume-Uni, ou GIUK, que l'Otan (Organisation du traité de l'Atlantique nord) considère comme essentiel à la surveillance des mouvements de la Russie vers l'océan Atlantique. Le pays nordique ne dispose pas d'armée et sa défense repose sur l'Otan ainsi que sur un accord bilatéral avec les États-Unis, signé en 1951. Selon des experts, les droits de douane imposés par Donald Trump et ses menaces sur le Groenland ont amené les Islandais à réévaluer des certitudes de longue date, même si la décision d'organiser ce référendum est antérieure à son second mandat. "L'affaire du Groenland a poussé les Islandais à réexaminer leur relation avec les États-Unis et à se demander s'ils sont encore un partenaire fiable. Cela n'avait jamais été une préoccupation jusqu'à présent", a indiqué Eirikur Bergmann. La ministre des Affaires étrangères, Thorgerdhur Katrin Gunnarsdottir, a déclaré à Reuters que l'Otan et l'accord avec Washington resteraient le fondement de la sécurité islandaise quel que soit le résultat du scrutin, mais l'adhésion à l'UE pourrait néanmoins constituer "un atout important", notamment sur le plan de la sécurité économique. "Nous sommes déçus par la campagne de pression menée contre les Groenlandais et le Danemark", a-t-elle dit au sujet des menaces de Donald Trump. La principale inquiétude reste toutefois la Russie, a-t-elle ajouté, citant la guerre en Ukraine et ses activités maritimes dans les eaux islandaises et à proximité, dans l'Atlantique Nord.

item.title: Au moins 14 nourrissons tués dans un incendie dans un hôpital d'Islamabad
item.description: Au moins 14 nourrissons ont été tués mercredi dans un incendie dans un hôpital public d'Islamabad, la capitale du Pakistan, a déclaré le Premier ministre pakistanais Shehbaz Sharif.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Au moins 14 nourrissons ont été tués mercredi dans un incendie dans un hôpital public d'Islamabad, la capitale du Pakistan, a déclaré le Premier ministre pakistanais Shehbaz Sharif. Selon la chaîne locale Geo TV, l'incendie s'est déclaré vers 02h00 GMT au Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), au troisième étage du service de santé maternelle et infantile de l'établissement. L'incendie a été provoqué par un dysfonctionnement des systèmes de climatisation, a ajouté Geo TV, qui avait fait état de 15 décès de nourrissons dans l'incident. "Rendez-moi mon enfant", s'est exclamée Javeria, qui a perdu son nouveau-né, devant l'hôpital, où des ambulances s'étaient rassemblées. "Je veux que justice soit faite." Shehbaz Sharif a ordonné aux autorités de mener une enquête immédiate, a indiqué son cabinet. "Les responsables doivent être identifiés et les mesures les plus sévères doivent être prises", a déclaré le cabinet dans un communiqué. Le service a été bouclé et des ambulances ont été aperçues à l'extérieur du bâtiment de l'hôpital, selon un témoin de Reuters. Mudasir, un parent qui a perdu son enfant, a déclaré que toutes les portes du service, à l'exception d'une seule, étaient fermées et qu'il n'y avait "aucune mesure de sécurité incendie" dans le service. Ni l'hôpital ni les autorités n'ont fait de commentaire dans l'immédiat sur cet incident. Le PIMS, situé au coeur d'Islamabad, où l'ancien Premier ministre Imran Khan a été brièvement soigné la semaine dernière, est l'un des principaux hôpitaux publics de la ville.

item.title: Hyundai Motor-Relève son objectif de marge et élargit sa gamme de véhicules hybrides
item.description: Hyundai Motor a dévoilé mercredi son plan d'ajouter 1,27 million d'unités de capacité de production d'ici 2030 et d'élargir sa gamme de véhicules hybrides aux États-Unis, cherchant à porter sa marge bénéficiaire d'exploitation au-dessus de 9% d'ici quatre ans.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hyundai Motor (005380.KS) a dévoilé mercredi son plan d'ajouter 1,27 million d'unités de capacité de production d'ici 2030 et d'élargir sa gamme de véhicules hybrides aux États-Unis, cherchant à porter sa marge bénéficiaire d'exploitation au-dessus de 9% d'ici quatre ans. Le constructeur automobile sud-coréen a annoncé qu'il lancerait ou renouvellerait plus de 100 véhicules dans le monde d'ici 2030, dont plus de la moitié en Amérique du Nord, dans le but de regagner du terrain face à ses concurrents et de pénétrer de nouveaux segments. L'entreprise entend également accélérer la production aux États-Unis, notamment avec la fabrication de Santa Fe, un véhicule électrique (VE) à autonomie prolongée (EREV), au sein de l'usine Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Alabama. "Il s'agit d'une offensive produit déployée dans toutes les régions", selon le groupe, ajoutant cibler également les segments de marché où sa marque est actuellement sous-représentée. "Ces segments représentent environ 29% des ventes automobiles totales, ce qui souligne d'importantes opportunités de croissance", at-il précisé. Hyundai Motor a annoncé relever son objectif de marge opérationnelle consolidée pour 2030, le faisant passer de la fourchette de 8% à 9% précédemment prévue à plus de 9%, tout en maintenant ses prévisions de marge pour 2026 entre 6,3% et 7,3%. Le constructeur a également réaffirmé son objectif de 5,55 millions de véhicules vendus dans le monde d'ici 2030, soit une part de marché de 6%, et a indiqué que les VE représenteraient alors 60% des ventes, contre 23% en 2025. "Nos fondamentaux n'ont jamais été aussi solides", a déclaré le directeur général José Munoz, soulignant la position mondiale du groupe. Hyundai Motor, avec sa filiale Kia Corp (000270.KS) , est le troisième constructeur automobile mondial en termes de ventes. RISQUES ET ROBOTS L'offensive de Hyundai Motor aux États-Unis intervient alors que la hausse des prix de l'essence, liée à la guerre en Iran, a renforcé la demande de véhicules économes en carburant, notamment les hybrides. Selon les données de Cox Automotive, environ 56% des acheteurs de voitures américains ont déclaré que la hausse des prix de l'essence les incitait davantage à envisager l'achat d'un véhicule hybride, dont les ventes ont progressé de 19% au premier semestre 2026. Les ventes d'hybrides de Hyundai Motor ont quant à elles bondi de 71% au deuxième trimestre. Cependant, l'expansion de la société aux États-Unis est également confrontée à un risque lié à la politique commerciale dans le cadre de la révision en cours de l'Accord États-Unis-Mexique-Canada (AEUMC). Les autorités américaines ont refusé de reconduire automatiquement l'accord, ce qui laisse entrevoir la possibilité d'examens annuels et une moindre visibilité pour les projets d'investissement à forte intensité capitalistique dépendant de chaînes d'approvisionnement transfrontalières. Hyundai Motor a également présenté son plan de diversification, notamment dans les domaines de la robotique, de la conduite autonome et des robotaxis. Le constructeur entend lancer la production de robots aux États-Unis en 2028, avec un objectif de 30.000 unités par an. Il prévoit de déployer le robot humanoïde Atlas de Boston Dynamics dans son usine Metaplant en Géorgie à partir de 2028. L'entreprise a ajouté qu'elle mettrait en service un centre de données d'IA de 100 mégawatts à partir de 2029, dans le cadre de son expansion dans le domaine des véhicules définis par logiciel et des systèmes de conduite autonome. Elle a également annoncé l'annulation d'actions propres d'une valeur d'environ 789 milliards de wons (488,54 millions d'euros), tout en maintenant un taux de distribution aux actionnaires d'au moins 35%. A la Bourse de Séoul, l'action reculait de 3,3% mercredi vers 05h57 GMT, contre une progression de 1,3% pour l'indice de référence (.KS11) au même moment.

item.title: CD Projekt RED to launch remastered version of 'The Witcher 3' ahead of new expansion
item.description: CD Projekt RED will publish a remastered version of its 2015 blockbuster "The Witcher 3" on September 29, ahead of a 2027 launch of a new expansion for the video game, it said late on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Adrianna Ebert
item.content:encoded: CD Projekt RED (CDR.WA) will publish a remastered version of its 2015 blockbuster "The Witcher 3" on September 29, ahead of a 2027 launch of a new expansion for the video game, it said late on Tuesday. Poland's biggest video game developer showcased a trailer for "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered" and a teaser trailer for its upcoming third expansion, titled "Songs of the Past", at the Opening Night Live of the world's biggest video game trade fair Gamescom. It did not specify a release date for the expansion, but confirmed the 2027 launch. "The Witcher 3", a winner of more than 250 Game of the Year awards, is among the world's all-time best-sellers, with more than 65 million copies sold since its launch. "We expect the remaster launch to have a meaningful positive impact on the company’s fourth quarter results, while also helping to further expand The Witcher 3 installed base ahead of the release of Songs of the Past, potentially to 70-75 million copies by then," Erste Group analyst Krzysztof Tkocz said in a note to investors. The remastered version will be available as a free upgrade to all owners of the original game on GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. The game will also get a native version for Nintendo Switch 2. All current owners of the base game will also gain free access to the two existing expansions to "The Witcher 3", and both of them will be included in the remastered version. "This maps a great opportunity for people ... to jump in with the improvements on the remaster update and get a whole lot of stuff for free before we ship the Songs of the Past," CD Projekt RED level design lead Miles Tost said after the trailer showcase. Offering the remaster free of charge should further strengthen players' trust in the company, Tkocz wrote, noting that many developers release them as separate paid products. (This story has been corrected to fix a typo in Miles Tost's surname in paragraph 8.)

item.title: South African rand steady with key US inflation data in focus
item.description: The South African rand was steady in early trade on Wednesday, with caution prevailing among investors ahead of key U.S. inflation data that could set the tone for the commodity-linked currency.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The South African rand was steady in early trade on Wednesday, with caution prevailing among investors ahead of key U.S. inflation data that could set the tone for the commodity-linked currency. At 0604 GMT, the rand traded at 15.9276 against the dollar , unchanged from its previous close. The dollar remained pinned in the narrow trading range it has sat in for the past week against most major peers ahead of the release of the U.S. Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index for July at 1230 GMT, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge. Investors are also looking ahead to the Fed's annual Jackson Hole symposium later this week for further clues on the U.S. central bank's policy outlook. "The rand is benefiting from a lower dollar and steady to better commodity prices," Adam Phillips of Umkhulu Treasury said. In the absence of major domestic economic data, the rand, like other risk-sensitive currencies, tends to be driven by global factors, including U.S. economic data releases and policy developments. South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond was slightly firmer in early deals, as the yield fell 1 basis point to 8.435%.

item.title: Nepal flash flood washes away villages, damages roads, power projects
item.description: A massive flash flood in the Himalayan nation of Nepal washed away villages while damaging roads, bridges and power projects in a region bordering Tibet, authorities said on Wednesday, as they warned against the risk of casualties.
item.dc:creator: Gopal Sharma
item.content:encoded: A massive flash flood in the Himalayan nation of Nepal washed away villages while damaging roads, bridges and power projects in a region bordering Tibet, authorities said on Wednesday, as they warned against the risk of casualties. The areas of Syapru Besi and Timure in the mountainous district of Rasuwa, with a population of about 50,000, were severely affected, officials said, while urging those living on the banks of the Bhote Koshi river to seek higher ground. "We have reports of villages and infrastructure project sites being washed away," district administrator Narendra Pariyar told Reuters, although no immediate estimates of casualties or property losses were available. "There could be heavy casualties or loss of property," he added. "But I cannot say for sure now." The reason for the inundation was not immediately clear but a deadly flash flood on the same river last year was eventually traced to the draining of a glacier lake. Nepal's water resources ministry said hydroelectric projects were among the infrastructure damaged by the floods, along with roads and bridges. Electricity supply in the area has been disrupted as a result of such damage, the government added. Prime Minister Balendra Shah said rescue and relief teams, as well as police and the military had been dispatched to help in the aid effort. "Instructions have been given ... to move the people living in the lower areas to safer places," he said. "People along the river are advised to exercise extra caution and remain alert." The Bhote Koshi river originates in Tibet and empties into Nepal's Trishuli river that eventually flows into India as the Gandak river. Last year's flood in the Bhote Koshi killed nine people, with 24 missing, and washed away a 'Friendship Bridge' linking Nepal and China to disrupt trade and transport for months. That flood was triggered by the draining of a supraglacial lake in Tibet, a regional climate monitor said.

item.title: British energy price cap to rise 4% as Iran war pushes up costs
item.description: Most British households will see their energy bills rise from October after energy regulator Ofgem announced a 4% hike in its domestic price cap as the war in Iran pushes up wholesale costs.
item.dc:creator: Susanna Twidale
item.content:encoded: Most British households will see their energy bills rise from October after energy regulator Ofgem announced a 4% hike in its domestic price cap as the war in Iran pushes up wholesale costs. The rise will be a blow to the new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, who has pledged to ease cost-of-living pressures, and more than wipes out measures he announced last month to [USN:L6N43N09D TEXT:"cut tax on electricity bills."] "High international gas prices are continuing to drive energy costs in the UK. We welcome the government’s intervention to remove VAT from electricity bills, without which customers would have faced even higher costs this winter,” said Neil Kenward, Ofgem’s director general for markets. The increase, a £60 rise to £1,723 ($2,348) from the previous cap for July to September, will hit around 22 million households on variable tariffs, with the price cap covering around 65% of customers. WHOLESALE ENERGY PRICES HAVE SOARED Benchmark wholesale British gas prices have more than doubled since the U.S. began military action against Iran on February 28, severely curbing shipping through the [USN:L1N4100GE TEXT:"Strait of Hormuz"], the transit route for a fifth of the world's liquefied natural gas. Wholesale costs are the biggest single driver of Ofgem's quarterly price cap, which limits what suppliers can charge households and also reflects network and policy costs. Britain’s energy minister said consumers will be concerned about the costs of bills this winter. "We will keep looking at what more we can do to protect families from unaffordable bills," Miatta Fahnbulleh said in a statement. The removal of the VAT on electricity prevented the cap from rising by an additional £45. In April the government also shifted some levies to cut around £150 from an average bill. WORSE TO COME With little sign of an end to the conflict between the U.S. and Iran, analysts forecast wholesale energy costs are likely to remain elevated and the price cap could continue to rise. Analysts at Cornwall Insight forecasts that at current wholesale prices, the cap could rise a further 9% in January to £1,872. "Even if we saw an end to the conflict, lower stocks going into winter as demand increases mean falling bills in January (are) unlikely," said Craig Lowrey, principal consultant at Cornwall Insight. ($1 = 0.7337 pounds)

item.title: Couche-Tard launches tender offer for all shares of Poland's Zabka
item.description: Canada's Alimentation Couche-Tard said on Wednesday it was launching a voluntary tender offer for all shares of Polish convenience store chain Zabka at 32 zlotys each, in line with its earlier plans.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Canada's Alimentation Couche-Tard (ATD.TO) said on Wednesday it was launching a voluntary tender offer for all shares of Polish convenience store chain Zabka (ZAB.WA) at 32 zlotys each, in line with [USN:L4N43X0EI TEXT:"its earlier plans"]. The offer, which is set to run from Thursday until September 25, is 2.3% higher than Zabka's last closing price of 31.28 zlotys on the Warsaw bourse and values the company at roughly 32.6 billion zlotys ($8.8 billion). Couche-Tard said in July it planned to buy Zabka in the Canadian convenience store operator's biggest deal to date, after dropping a $46 billion approach for Japan's Seven & I (3382.T) last year. Circle K Polska, a Couche-Tard subsidiary, will acquire the shares, with Ipopema Securities acting as the intermediary. Couche-Tard expects the acquisition to create around $250 million in annual cost benefits within three years, and said it could seek to delist Zabka if it gains at least 95% ownership. Zabka operates roughly 13,000 stores across Poland and Romania, with its Polish stores located within 500 metres of residents' homes on average. ($1 = 3.6902 zlotys)

item.title: How a Ukrainian commander sped through the 'kill zone' to save wounded troops
item.description: Seeing two wounded fighters stranded on the battlefield — one of them still strapped to a land drone immobilized by a Russian strike — Ukrainian commander Vladyslav Polskyi knew he had to do something.
item.dc:creator: Vitalii Hnidyi, Dan Peleschuk
item.content:encoded: Seeing two wounded fighters stranded on the battlefield — one of them still strapped to a land drone immobilized by a Russian strike — Ukrainian commander Vladyslav Polskyi knew he had to do something. The 29-year-old — a former science teacher who joined the army in 2023 — was watching the soldiers on a screen in his command post around 15 km (9 miles) away. Between them stretched the "kill zone" , riddled with mines and swarmed by aerial drones ready to attack anything that moved. Polskyi, whose military call-sign is "Teacher", hopped into his grey pick-up truck and raced past scorched fields and the charred husks of other vehicles left on the battlefield of northern Ukraine. He had no helmet or body armour. "If it had happened to me, I would've wanted them to come take me away, and not just leave me there," the junior lieutenant told Reuters, recalling his August 15 mission to save both men, who were members of another battalion. His feat captured the country's attention and earned him its highest military honour, Hero of Ukraine, days later. President Volodymyr Zelenskiy presented him with the award at [USN:L8N44L0A5 TEXT:"Independence Day celebrations"] in Kyiv on Monday. "People must be taken care of. Thank you, Vladyslav!" Zelenskiy said, announcing the award. STRANDED DRONE SHOWED LIMITS OF BATTLEFIELD TECH Speaking to Reuters less than a week after the operation, Polskyi described speeding toward the men while planning how he would load them onto the flatbed of the truck. The two Ukrainian soldiers had been wounded during a combat mission in the Kharkiv region and were being evacuated atop an unmanned ground vehicle when it was struck by one of Russia's small, agile helicopter drones loaded with explosives. Kyiv's forces have been using remote-controlled unmanned vehicles to help limit human involvement in dangerous tasks like evacuations inside the "kill zone", seeking an edge against Moscow's bigger army. Russia's successful attack cast light on the limits of the relatively slow and rudimentary vehicles. The Russian drone knocked out the land drone's Starlink terminal, severing the link with its pilot and leaving it immobilized. One of the wounded soldiers had managed to crawl into a ditch off the road and hide in the vegetation; the other lay helpless on the four-wheeled vehicle under an open sky, his right foot dangling from the bone. Ukraine has also made widespread use of attack drones on the battlefield, and says it is killing or wounding around 30,000 Russian soldiers a month - a figure Moscow dismisses as exaggerated. Both sides frequently post videos of drones hunting down each other's soldiers in the "kill zone". Surveillance drone footage, obtained exclusively by Reuters from Polskyi's unit, the 475th Assault Regiment, shows his truck hurtling down a gravel road before turning and rapidly reversing toward the damaged drone. Reuters was able to verify the exact location of the rescue using the full-length footage. However, the regiment asked not to disclose where it took place for security reasons. At another nearby command post, drone-platoon leader "Malyi" watched as the rescue played out on screens in real time. "Everyone in the command centre was shocked," said the 22-year-old, who asked to be identified by his call-sign. Just a single Russian drone or land mine could have killed all three men, he added. Polskyi — dressed in T-shirt and shorts — hoisted both men onto his truck and raced home, managing to evade the flying Russian drones that had been detected heading toward their new target. Looking back, he remembered the fear in the men's eyes. He was afraid too. "But you need to know how to control it," he said.

item.title: Trump remite al Congreso el acuerdo nuclear con Arabia Saudita, pero pide reconocer a Israel
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ha remitido al Congreso una propuesta de acuerdo con Arabia Saudita sobre energía nuclear civil, al tiempo que insiste en que el pacto solo entrará en vigor si el reino normaliza sus relaciones con Israel, dijo el martes a Reuters un funcionario del Gobierno estadounidense.
item.dc:creator: Timothy Gardner
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ha remitido al Congreso una propuesta de acuerdo con Arabia Saudita sobre energía nuclear civil, al tiempo que insiste en que el pacto solo entrará en vigor si el reino normaliza sus relaciones con Israel, dijo el martes a Reuters un funcionario del Gobierno estadounidense. El acuerdo, que se alcanzó en julio y permitiría a las empresas estadounidenses exportar tecnología nuclear civil al reino, se remitió al Congreso el lunes, según el funcionario estadounidense, que prefirió mantener el anonimato. La embajada saudita en Washington no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. No estaba claro cómo espera Trump que el hecho de remitir el acuerdo nuclear al Congreso —que dispone de 90 días de sesión para examinarlo— contribuya a sus objetivos. "La postura del presidente no ha cambiado: el acuerdo solo seguirá adelante si Arabia Saudita se suma a los Acuerdos de Abraham", afirmó el funcionario estadounidense en un correo electrónico, refiriéndose a los acuerdos negociados por Estados Unidos entre Israel y países de mayoría árabe y musulmana para normalizar las relaciones. Dichos acuerdos, alcanzados en 2020 y 2021, se firmaron entre Israel y Emiratos Árabes Unidos, Baréin, Marruecos y Sudán. Días después de acordar el pacto nuclear con Arabia Saudita en julio, Trump —quien trabajó en un pacto similar durante su primer mandato— estableció la normalización como condición para que entrara en vigor. El expresidente Joe Biden también impulsó un acuerdo nuclear y quiso vincularlo a dichos pactos. Los diplomáticos pensaban que Riad estaba cerca de normalizar las relaciones con Israel en 2023, pero el inicio de la guerra de Israel contra Gaza en octubre de 2023 cambió el panorama. Arabia Saudita ha exigido una vía irreversible hacia un Estado palestino antes de reconocer a Israel. El acuerdo nuclear, de 30 años de duración, prevé la construcción de reactores AP1000, un proyecto valorado en decenas de miles de millones de dólares que beneficiaría a Westinghouse, propiedad conjunta de la canadiense Cameco (CCO.TO) y Brookfield Asset Management (BAM.N) . El acuerdo se ha remitido a los líderes del Congreso y se espera que se remita a las comisiones el miércoles, han indicado dos fuentes del Congreso. A menos que el Congreso se oponga al acuerdo en un plazo de 90 días de sesión, este entrará en vigor. Si el Congreso rechazara el acuerdo, Trump podría vetar esa decisión, lo que requeriría una mayoría de dos tercios en el Congreso para anularlo. "LEJOS DE SER IDEAL" Algunos legisladores demócratas y defensores de la no proliferación han criticado el pacto nuclear por no prohibir a Arabia Saudita el enriquecimiento de uranio ni el reprocesamiento de residuos nucleares, dos vías potenciales para fabricar un arma nuclear. Emiratos Árabes Unidos aceptó dichas medidas, conocidas como el "estándar de oro", en su acuerdo nuclear civil de 2009 con Washington. El Gobierno de Trump afirma que el acuerdo incluye las medidas de no proliferación exigidas por la ley. Al iniciar el proceso, Trump ha abierto la posibilidad de que el Congreso permita que el acuerdo siga adelante sin las cláusulas de normalización y no proliferación, afirmó Henry Sokolski, director del Centro de Educación sobre Políticas de No Proliferación. "Esto dista mucho de ser ideal si se toma en serio la prohibición del enriquecimiento y el reconocimiento de Israel", señaló Sokolski.

item.title: Harry and Meghan's media storm shows the power and peril of their brand
item.description: If Prince Harry and his wife Meghan were hoping the press would give them an easier time on their return to Britain, the frenzied reporting around her potential new acting role may indicate how they, and their brand, will fare.
item.dc:creator: Kate Holton, Francesca Halliwell
item.content:encoded: If Prince Harry and his wife Meghan were hoping the press would give them an easier time on their return to Britain, the frenzied reporting around her [USN:L6N44I104 TEXT:"potential new acting role"] may indicate how they, and their brand, will fare. With most royal commentators flummoxed by the couple's [USN:L1N44H0DC TEXT:"imminent return"] to Britain six years after they left for the U.S., reports emerged that Meghan was in talks to appear in a Guy Ritchie Netflix crime drama, before a new report said a backlash had prompted the offer to be withdrawn. While neither side confirmed nor denied any talks, branding experts said it showed what the couple would offer to brands and entertainment groups as they build their life outside the royal family: huge media interest, polarised opinions and drama. But it also shows the challenge they will face as they seek to promote the charities and brands they work with and attempt to maintain some kind of privacy, in a country where polling shows they have become unpopular, at least among older people. "You can't buy this kind of publicity for a TV show," entertainment journalist Caroline Frost told Reuters. Mark Borkowski, a British PR guru, agreed: "Both Harry and Meghan give people visibility. They can generate an audience." COUPLE CITED INTENSE SCRUTINY AS REASON TO LEAVE Harry, the 41-year-old younger son of King Charles, and Meghan, 45, are returning to Britain [USN:L1N44G14R TEXT:"six years"] after they cited the [USN:L8N44H0TT TEXT:"intense media scrutiny"] as one reason they were quitting royal duties to carve out independent careers, backed by commercial tie-ups. In the early years they made headlines around the world when, through an interview with Oprah Winfrey, a Netflix documentary series and Harry's autobiography "Spare", they criticised the royal family and lambasted the British press. Borkowski said the "trashing of the royal family" angered many people in Britain, where a July YouGov poll showed that 64% of respondents want to retain the monarchy. "People just found it unpalatable that he was attacking the very family that brought him up," he said. Since then a reported $100 million Netflix deal and a $20 million Spotify agreement have been downgraded and brought to an end respectively, while Meghan's lifestyle brand As Ever has struggled to take off — setbacks that have all been reported with glee by some British newspapers. RETURN TO ENGLAND COULD REFRESH MEGHAN'S BRAND Branding experts said a return to Britain could offer the chance for a reset. Pauline MacLaran, professor of marketing at Royal Holloway University, said a move to the English countryside could work well for Meghan's lifestyle brand, which sells spreads, candles, teas and wine in the U.S. "Her coming to England could really bring about a new story, the English touch, the English flavour. And I think that would be very popular with her American consumers to refresh the brand," she said, adding that Meghan would likely struggle to sell in Britain. Catherine Mayer, an author who has written about the treatment of women in the royal family, said while there was initially a lot of excitement when Meghan first moved to Britain, the fairytale curdled quickly. "She has had some of the worst coverage, and consistently terrible coverage, that I have seen in all my research," she said, adding that inevitably affected their business interests. To their supporters, Harry and Meghan were a young couple forced to flee Britain to avoid racist and misogynistic reporting, unwilling to play the game where the press and the royals cooperate to keep the monarchy at the centre of the national story. To their detractors they sold their story to the highest bidder, making tens of millions of pounds by dishing the dirt on Harry's family, threatening the future of the institution and all while demanding their own privacy. To add to the picture, Harry has also in recent years [USN:L1N44I09Z TEXT:"sued many of Britain's leading tabloids"] for invasions of privacy. Entertainment journalist Frost said Britons can be quick to judge but they respect those who work hard - and a return to acting for Meghan, particularly on the stage, could change the narrative. She added, however, that it could also be hard for someone so famous to disappear into a role. Borkowski said both Harry and Meghan were assured performers in public, capable of drawing attention to any charities they work with, but they would need a new approach to handle the intense scrutiny from social and legacy media that will resume. "If they listen to good advice and they surround themselves with good people, then I think the future's bright," he said.

item.title: In rialzo in vista risultati Nvidia, greggio cala su speranze Hormuz
item.description: I mercati azionari asiatici guadagnano terreno, con il calo dei prezzi del petrolio che fa scendere i rendimenti obbligazionari sulle speranze di una riapertura a breve dello strategico Stretto di Hormuz, in attesa della pubblicazione dei risultati di Nvidia, azienda leader nel settore dell'IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I mercati azionari asiatici guadagnano terreno, con il calo dei prezzi del petrolio che fa scendere i rendimenti obbligazionari sulle speranze di una riapertura a breve dello strategico Stretto di Hormuz, in attesa della pubblicazione dei risultati di Nvidia, azienda leader nel settore dell'IA. ** L'Iran ha detto di avere ripreso i colloqui con l'Oman sulla gestione dello Stretto, sotto la crescente pressione economica esercitata dall'amministrazione Trump. Il conflitto, che si protrae da quasi sei mesi, ha scosso i mercati petroliferi e alimentato timori inflazionistici su scala globale. ** I futures sul Brent scendono per il terzo giorno consecutivo, perdendo l'1,85% a 86,92 dollari il barile, sulla scia delle prospettive di un aumento dell'offerta attraverso lo Stretto, da cui prima della guerra transitava un quinto del commercio mondiale di petrolio. ** Gli investitori attendono in giornata i risultati del secondo trimestre di Nvidia (NVDA.O) . L'attenzione è puntata sulla tenuta del boom degli investimenti nell'intelligenza artificiale e sulla capacità dell'azienda di generare utili all'altezza delle aspettative di mercato. ** L’indice più ampio di MSCI relativo ai titoli dell’Asia-Pacifico escluso il Giappone (.MISX00000PUS) registra un rialzo dello 0,85%. Il Nikkei giapponese (.N225) sale dello 0,78%, mentre il KOSPI (.KS11) , fortemente esposto al settore tech, guadagna l’1,06%. ** I futures sul Nasdaq registrano un calo dello 0,08%, mentre i futures europei salgono dello 0,14%. ** Gli operatori guardano anche ai nuovi dati sull'inflazione statunitense in uscita oggi, in attesa del simposio della Federal Reserve a Jackson Hole, in programma per questo fine settimana.

item.title: EEUU suspende temporalmente las citas para la solicitud de visados en todo el mundo
item.description: Estados Unidos ha suspendido temporalmente las citas para la tramitación de visados de solicitantes de todo el mundo, en el marco de la campaña de represión migratoria que está llevando a cabo el Gobierno del presidente republicano Donald Trump durante su segundo mandato en la Casa Blanca.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: Estados Unidos ha suspendido temporalmente las citas para la tramitación de visados de solicitantes de todo el mundo, en el marco de la campaña de represión migratoria que está llevando a cabo el Gobierno del presidente republicano Donald Trump durante su segundo mandato en la Casa Blanca. Un portavoz del Departamento de Estado de EEUU dijo el martes que se ha puesto en marcha una iniciativa de formación a escala mundial en todas las embajadas y consulados estadounidenses del mundo, y que las citas para los servicios de visados se ajustarán para dar cabida a dicha formación. Trump ha llevado a cabo una agresiva campaña de deportaciones y medidas de represión en materia de inmigración que incluye la revocación de visados y permisos de residencia, así como el rechazo de solicitudes por diversos motivos, como opiniones políticas y protestas a favor de Palestina contra el ataque de Israel, aliado de EEUU, a Gaza. Afirma que esta campaña de represión tiene como objetivo mejorar la seguridad nacional. La campaña ha sufrido algunos reveses legales. El viernes, un juez estadounidense anuló una política de la Administración de Trump que suspendía la expedición de visados de inmigrante a solicitantes de 75 países, alegando que dicha política excedía la autoridad legal del secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio. El Departamento de Estado no especificó detalles sobre la formación ni su calendario, más allá de indicar que la formación tenía como objetivo ayudar a los funcionarios consulares a descartar a los solicitantes que se considerara que probablemente pasarían a depender de las prestaciones públicas estadounidenses y garantizar una evaluación de los solicitantes de visado "exhaustiva y coherente". La suspensión de las citas para visados ya había sido adelantada por el Financial Times, que señaló que los solicitantes de visados de inmigrante con entrevistas programadas en embajadas y consulados de EEUU habían recibido correos electrónicos en los que se les informaba de que sus citas se estaban reprogramando y de que recibirían una notificación posterior con una nueva fecha. La campaña de Trump contra la inmigración ha sido ampliamente condenada por grupos de derechos humanos por considerarla discriminatoria y contraria a la libertad de expresión y al derecho a un proceso justo. Los grupos de derechos humanos también afirman que esta campaña ha creado un entorno inseguro en EEUU, especialmente para las minorías étnicas, que han expresado su preocupación por la discriminación racial. Aunque Trump hizo campaña en 2024 con la promesa de poner fin a la inmigración irregular, su Gobierno también ha dificultado la inmigración regular, por ejemplo, imponiendo nuevas y costosas tasas a los solicitantes de determinados visados de trabajo.
